column1: # realized_variance_optimal_sampling fixture data — Octave/MATLAB reference for parity testing
# Generated from ES_20090817.mat high-frequency E-mini S&P 500 futures trade data (Aug 17 2009)
# Source: realized/realized_variance_optimal_sampling.m — Bandi-Russell optimal sampling frequency selection
#   rv:            Realized variance at Bandi-Russell optimal sampling frequency
#   rvDebiased:    Debiased realized variance at optimal frequency (noise-adjusted)
#   rvSS:          Subsampled RV using optimal frequency
#   rvDebiasedSS:  Subsampled debiased RV using optimal frequency
#   diagnostics.m: Number of filtered returns (filtered price count - 1)
#   - 'unit' timeType is documented in realized_variance_optimal_sampling.m but not supported
#     The 'seconds' timeType scenario (scenario 6) provides equivalent coverage.
#   - Negative rvDebiased values can occur when noise dominates signal at high frequencies.
#   - rv and rvSS are identical when subsamples=1 (no subsampling offset averaging).
#   - diagnostics values are identical across subsample counts for same price/time/sampling config.
